name: Follower Reads
description: Read queries using AS OF SYSTEM TIME follower_read_timestamp() for replica routing

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_accounts (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, name STRING NOT NULL, balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
seed_sql: UPSERT INTO bench_accounts (id, name, balance) VALUES ($1, $2, 5000.0)

operations.name: follower_read
sql: SELECT name, balance FROM bench_accounts WHERE id = $1

operations.name: current_read
sql: SELECT name, balance FROM bench_accounts WHERE id = $1
